Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.body: The Flat Set respects your privacy. We collect minimal personal data required strictly for fulfilling furniture orders, managing DDP customs clearance, and communicating logistics milestones.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.body: Orders placed with The Flat Set are subject to 100-night in-home trials, DDP guaranteed delivery, and local charity donation return pathways under our circular ESG policy.
